top_signals.title: Solomon on Tech Supercycle 'Bumps'
top_signals.summary: Goldman’s David Solomon said there will be “bumps” during this technology supercycle, while praising the US economy as resilient. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: 230-plus immigrants arrested in crackdown targeting unauthorized CDL holders
top_signals.summary:
Federal and state authorities arrested more than 230 undocumented immigrants, including over 40 CDL holders, during a three-day operation spanning 15 states.

The post 230-plus immigrants arrested in crackdown targeting unauthorized CDL holders appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
top_signals.summary: Anthropic unveiled its S-1 prospectus last week, but the initial filing only included the company's financials through the first half of the year.

top_signals.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase following record hack
top_signals.summary: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Nov. 1.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
